fields.Current State: An arcane device marked 'Vocath' nearly killed a chamber of cadets; Mirt has named Vocath an old enemy, and a matching crate sits at the Sky Dock.
fields.Overview (Player): A wave of thefts and now an arcane attack have struck Caelestis. The device that nearly killed a chamber of cadets bore the marking 'Vocath' — an old enemy of Mirt who bears him a grudge, putting anyone connected to Mirt at risk. A crate at the Sky Dock carries the same symbol and routes through the quartermaster Mr. Blip. Mirt has asked the cadets to check the teaching rooms and look into Joffrey and a man named Jeffrey.

objectives.text: Recover the arcane device from the wrecked simulation chamber
Look into Joffrey and the man named Jeffrey
Trace the marked crate’s route through Mr. Blip

bullets: Caelestis had already grown tense from recent thefts before the cadets' first day
Boogie noticed a suspicious exchange between a dock officer and a merchant at the sky dock
The attack on Mirt was likely a diversion; Mr. Blip and officers confirmed more burglaries struck the academy simultaneously
Tumak warned the crew that things were going missing all over the academy
Saerthe's personal miniature spelljamming ship was revealed stolen — the same model as the incomplete ship inside Boogie
An arcane device marked 'Vocath' detonated in the simulation chamber, nearly killing everyone inside
Mirt named Vocath as an old enemy bearing him a grudge, making anyone connected to him a target
A crate at the Sky Dock bore the same symbol as the rod; its contents route through Mr. Blip toward Toril and H’catha
Mirt asked the cadets to check the teaching rooms for similar devices and to look cautiously into Joffrey and a man named Jeffrey

links.name: Marked Crate at the Sky Dock

children.name: The Living Clue in the Crate

name: The Living Clue in the Crate

fields.Current State: A live centipede creature from the crate is held as evidence, its meaning unknown.
fields.Overview (Player): One of the creatures that burst from Mirt's crate was captured alive and kept as evidence. What it is and where it came from remains unknown.

bullets: Worm-like centipede creatures burst from the crate meant for Mirt
Sol subdued the last one alive, sensing it might matter as evidence, and Mirt praised the choice

fields.Current State: A meteor has struck H’catha, the world beyond which Viren lies, and the crew is bound there aboard a tyrant ship.
fields.Overview (Player): A vision in Mirt's wardrobe and a familiar voice told Casey to 'Go there' — a place beyond H’catha in the Viren star system. Now a meteor has struck H’catha itself, and the crew is bound there aboard a tyrant ship. Casey carries the constellations that point the way.

objectives.text: Find Zerathis, or charts and word of him

bullets: Inside Mirt's wardrobe Casey saw unfamiliar constellations and a flickering point, and a familiar voice told him 'Go there'
Casey etched the constellation pattern onto a stolen shirt
Mirt revealed the wardrobe replicates a place beyond H’catha in the Viren star system, gifted by the spellcaster Zerathis
Casey sat at the Sky Dock thinking of his brother when the same familiar presence settled beside him again, then departed before he rose
An adamantine meteor struck the spire on H’catha, the beholder world beyond which Viren lies, and the crew was sent to recover it aboard a tyrant ship

fields.Current State: Gregory feels a new, unexplained tug in his core drawing him somewhere unknown.
fields.Overview (Player): Since leaving his master, Gregory has felt a new pull in his core, drawing him toward a place he cannot name.

bullets: Farther from home and his master than ever, Gregory felt a new tug in his core drawing him somewhere unknown

fields.Current State: Boogie's dreams now fill with other versions of himself and a presence converging on him, deepening the mystery of the ship within.
fields.Overview (Player): A tiny, half-missing model spelljamming ship has formed inside Boogie, the same model as the one stolen from the instructor Saerthe. He cannot explain how it came to be, and now his sleep fills with visions of countless other versions of himself and a presence converging on him.

bullets: Boogie pulled a tiny model spelljamming ship from his chest, half of it missing, with no explanation for how it formed or why it is incomplete
Boogie set the ship on the table for the crew, but none took up its meaning
Revealed that the ship is the same model as the miniature vessel stolen from Saerthe — a link Boogie has not spoken aloud
Boogie confirmed the half-ship and the derelict logbook both still rest within his chest
Dreamed of countless other versions of himself in an infinite dark, a presence pressing down through them toward him, and woke half-dissolved

fields.Current State: Tumak is searching for his family, now with the crew pledged to help.
fields.Overview (Player): Tumak is searching for a family he cannot yet name. The crew has promised to help him find them.

bullets: Tumak admitted to Boogie that he is searching for his own family
Boogie answered that now they have a crew, and the crew would help him find them

children.name: Tumak's Runes and the Tether Home

fields.Current State: Beshaba's laugh has passed, but a new curious voice now speaks to Sol of fate and whether he has escaped his origin.
fields.Overview (Player): When Sol spent his own luck to spare a crewmate, a woman's laughter answered — and he knew it for Beshaba. Now a curious, unhurried voice speaks to him in the night of fate and whether he has truly escaped his origin, saying it looks forward to watching how he wields what lies ahead. What these presences want of him is not yet clear.

bullets: Sol took a stroke of misfortune onto himself to save Boogie's jump, his strength dropping in a measured amount
As it left him, a woman laughed three times, and by the third he understood it was Beshaba
Gregory and Bartholomew saw a hair-thin arc of black lightning flicker out of Sol and back
In the night a curious, unhurried voice asked Sol why he embraced chaos and whether he had truly escaped where he came from
The voice said it now had his attention, that fate could still be wielded, and that it looked forward to watching him wield it

name: Tumak's Runes and the Tether Home

fields.Current State: Tumak's powers surface unbidden aboard the tyrant ship; his soul knife's portal is a piece of the home he seeks, and its tether a connection to it.
fields.Overview (Player): Tumak has begun to manifest powers he does not understand — telepathy, fire, and a soul knife drawn through a small portal — and bears two glowing half-runes, each half of a separate whole. When he called the knife, his runes flared and he felt a tether toward the home he has been seeking, and a voice he calls the Runekeeper spoke of all things finding their way home.

bullets: Tumak found a dim blue half-rune glowing on the sole of his left foot and a second, different mark on his right shoulder — two halves of two separate wholes
Tumak opened a telepathic link and cast his first fire bolt, magic he did not understand and did not know he had
Summoning his soul knife for the first time, his runes flared and he felt not where home is but a connection to it — the little portal the knife came through a piece of that somewhere
As the throw went wide, the Runekeeper said all things find their way home, and the blade bent true

name: The Tyrant Ship and the H’catha Meteor

fields.Related Character(s): Bartholomew Grayson, Gregory, Tumak Swan, Sol Fortuna, Casey Geim, Boogie
fields.Current State: The crew cleared the hold and the garden shaft aboard the tyrant ship but chose to hold and rest, bloodied, before descending to the deck below.
fields.Overview (Player): Boatswain Tarto has sent the crew to recover an adamantine meteor that struck the spire on H’catha, a world of beholders. Arriving as themselves is not an option. An abandoned tyrant ship drifts in Toril’s orbit: commandeer it, install a spelljamming helm on its command deck, and fly it through H’cathan space as one of their own — the vessel itself the disguise. Reach the spire under that cover and bring the meteor back.

objectives.text: Install the spelljamming helm on the command deck

rewards.name: The adamantine meteor
rewards.note: What the Boatswain sent them for

rewards.name: The tyrant ship
rewards.note: Theirs to keep, if they can hold it

bullets: Boatswain Tarto woke the crew at four in the morning to recover an adamantine meteor that struck the spire on H’catha
The plan: crew an abandoned beholder tyrant ship, install the helm on the command deck, and use its appearance to move through H’cathan space unchallenged
The Flighty Foundling dropped the crew into the tyrant ship's cargo deck and departed
The crew found and saved the broken autognome Ostekk-6, learning of a mimic aboard, a wisp bloom, and more clockwork horrors
The crew dispatched the clockwork horrors feeding on Ostekk-6, saved it, and cleared the lantern-wisp bloom choking the garden shaft
A magical floating dolly can bear the helm's weight, but the helm must still be routed up through the internal access shafts to the command deck
Ostekk-6 confirmed the shafts are impassable while the bloom holds, and that killing a flower does not unmake the wisps already loose
Bloodied and unrested, the crew decided for the first time not to press on, holding to recover before descending to the deck below by rope

fields.Current State: Mirt has named Vocath an old enemy who has borne him a grudge for a long time, which makes anyone connected to Mirt a target.
fields.Overview (Player): The arcane device that nearly killed a chamber of cadets carried a single marking: Vocath. Mirt knew the name at once. He has said only that Vocath has held a grudge against him for a long time, and that anyone connected to him is a potential target.

bullets: The rod recovered from the simulation chamber bore the marking Vocath
Saerthe raised an illusion of the rod before Mirt and named the marking
Mirt’s face went still — not confusion. He said Vocath had harboured a grudge against him for a long time
He told the cadets to keep it to themselves, and warned that anyone connected to him could be a target

fields.Current State: Ostekk-6 is saved but mute and broken, its core intact and its body beyond what magic can mend. It wears Gregory’s face and nobody has explained why.
fields.Overview (Player): The autognome the crew pulled out of the wreckage in the tyrant ship’s cargo hold wears Gregory’s face. Its core is sound; its body is a mechanical problem no spell will close. It speaks only through the link Tumak opened, and what it knows about the ship has already proved worth having.

bullets: Found in the cargo hold with its lower half gone and its voice box destroyed, the clockwork horrors still feeding on it
Gregory looked at its face and saw his own
The cargo manifest gave it a name: Ostekk-6
Its core is arcane and intact, but the frame is a physical repair beyond what the crew can do aboard
It warned of a mimic aboard, a spreading bloom, and more clockwork horrors

parent.name: The Tyrant Ship and the H’catha Meteor

fields.Related Character(s): Boogie, Casey Geim, Gregory, Sol Fortuna, Tumak Swan
fields.Current State: Complete. Every task on the orientation sheet was signed off on the cadets’ first day.
fields.Overview (Player): The first thing Caelestis ever asked of the crew: a printed list of six tasks, handed out by Boatswain Tarto, to be worked through in whatever order they liked. They did all six in a day — and in the course of it met the quartermaster, took their first turn at a helm, argued over bunks, and noticed a dock officer taking a bribe.

objectives.text: Collect the welcome pack from Administration
Report to quarters for bunk assignment
Report to the Sky Dock for spelljamming ship inspection
Collect service weaponry from Mister Blip in Stores
Report to the Spelljammer Nexus for basic training

bullets: Sor’Kur received them in Administration, her voice arriving in their minds rather than their ears
Bunks were settled the hard way — Veena went for Boogie’s corner, Sol stepped in behind him, and Tumak traded for something darker
At the Sky Dock they inspected a ship and saw a dock officer take a bribe; Gregory recalled the code of conduct that forbids it
Mr. Blip issued from Stores — Boogie charmed a light hammer out of him, and Gregory found the autognome unnervingly like himself
Saerthe ran their first helm exercise in the Nexus, over a floating field of miniature ships, under the tension of an ectoplasmic breach elsewhere in the tower
All of them finished the gymnasium assault course — Casey with ease, Sol by getting back up after a hard fall, Boogie hauling Gregory up the last climb
